book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Ni tal u Pablo isuuchil u yoleꞌ tiꞌ u puajeꞌ uvaꞌ nimolpeꞌ
As la val sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ ni niman u Jesúseꞌ tu unqꞌa tenameꞌ tu u Macedonia.

Tan kꞌuxh mamaꞌla kꞌaxkꞌo nipalebꞌe unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ, as kat chiibꞌ veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ taqꞌat unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ. As kꞌuxh meebꞌaꞌ chittuꞌ, as tul ni taqꞌ veꞌt u lochbꞌaleꞌ, as eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ nimal ipuaj ati.
As la val sete uvaꞌ kat taqꞌ veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ jankꞌal u lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat itxꞌol taqꞌataꞌ. As jit kuxheꞌ. Pet nimal kat taqꞌ veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ kat uch svatz,
tan vaꞌlik chit ijajat chajaak bꞌaꞌnil sve tiꞌ uvaꞌ la vaqꞌ tokebꞌal tiꞌ ilochat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ meebꞌaꞌ chittuꞌ tu u Judea uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús.

As jit kuxh taꞌn u lochbꞌaleꞌ kat ibꞌan unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu u Macedonia uvaꞌ nik qaleꞌ uvaꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ. Pet bꞌaxel kat toksa taama tiꞌ inimal u Kubꞌaal Jesús, echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ sqe uvaꞌ la kubꞌaneꞌ. As aꞌn kat inima veꞌt unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat qal ste tiꞌ u lochbꞌaleꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat unjaj bꞌaꞌnil te u Tito tiꞌ uvaꞌ kam ixeꞌtisat u Tito tiꞌ imolpu u nimla lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ la aqꞌpu te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ, as echat itzojpisataꞌ.

As at veꞌt kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Jesúseꞌ. As netootzi veꞌt isuuchil viyol u Tiixheꞌ. As echat veꞌt eyoloneꞌ. As ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ ebꞌanataꞌ kam uvaꞌ nisaꞌ u Tiixheꞌ setiꞌ, as tiꞌ exoꞌnit oꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ ni qal sete uvaꞌ ayaꞌloj chit ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ etaqꞌat u lochbꞌaleꞌ tetz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ.

As jit bꞌekꞌel ex nunbꞌaneꞌ. Pet aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ la etootzi uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tiꞌ taqꞌat u lochbꞌaleꞌ. As aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ echat koj la ebꞌaneꞌ. As aꞌeꞌ kꞌuchbꞌal tetz uvaꞌ xoꞌn unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ sete uvaꞌ echen tu u Judea.

As ootzimal vibꞌaꞌnil u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo setaꞌn, tan Aak ibꞌaal unqꞌa veeꞌ skajayil. As ech veꞌt Aakeꞌ meebꞌaꞌ kat ibꞌana tiꞌ kulochpeꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ nim veꞌt vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ la taqꞌ sqiꞌ. As ech veꞌt qatineꞌ echeꞌ txꞌioliqꞌii kat ibꞌana.
As tuk val etxumbꞌal tiꞌ uvaꞌ ni vitzꞌa setiꞌ, tan exeꞌ kat itzꞌan bꞌaxa umaꞌx veꞌt yaabꞌ tiꞌ imolpu unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ tetz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As exeꞌ kat xeꞌtisan tiꞌ imolpeꞌ bꞌaxa.

As la val sete cheel, emoltaj veꞌt unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat exeꞌtisa bꞌaxa. As etaqꞌtaj jankꞌoj uvaꞌ la uch sevatz. As kam chit uvaꞌ kat ok xeꞌ etaama bꞌaxa tiꞌ etaqꞌataꞌ, as echat la ebꞌaneꞌ tul la etzojpisa,

tan jankꞌal uvaꞌ la uch etaqꞌataꞌ, as la kꞌulpeꞌ tibꞌaꞌnil, asoj ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl tul la etaqꞌeꞌ. Pet yeꞌ la etaqꞌeꞌ, asoj yeꞌxhkam at sexeꞌ, tan yeꞌxhkam ni tal u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ techal la qaqꞌeꞌ, asoj yeꞌxhkam ati.
As jit aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ la kaa veꞌt ex meebꞌaꞌil tiꞌ elochat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. Pet aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ eela veꞌt ex la ibꞌan tukꞌ unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ.

As la txakon unbꞌooj unqꞌa etetzeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As elochtaj, tan xamtel as jit kuxh nim la chee veꞌt tetz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As aꞌeꞌ la lochon veꞌt ex unpajte. As eela kuxh elochat veꞌt etibꞌ la ebꞌaneꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ
echeꞌ ni tal umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Yeꞌ kat yaꞌlan kan unqꞌa tetz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nimal kat imola.
As kat tzꞌaj tetz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ bꞌiil kuxh kat imola, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: Estiꞌeꞌ ni vaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ, tan Aakeꞌ kat oksan veꞌt vitxumbꞌaleꞌ tu u taanxelal u Tito tiꞌ tok ilil setiꞌ echeꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ.
As tul kat qal te u Tito tiꞌ bꞌen tilat ex, as ayaꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl kat bꞌeni, tan kat chee tu u taanxelal tiꞌ bꞌen tilat ex unpajte.
As kat unchaj bꞌen umaꞌt u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tiꞌ u Tito uvaꞌ ootzimal veꞌt setaꞌn, as ootzimal tu unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan nilochoneꞌ tiꞌ ipaxsal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ.

As antu unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ kat txaaon veꞌt naj tiꞌ ibꞌen veꞌt sqiꞌ tul uvaꞌ la bꞌen qaqꞌ unqꞌa lochbꞌaleꞌ te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu u Jerusalén tiꞌ toksal iqꞌii u Jesúseꞌ. As la kukꞌucheꞌ uvaꞌ ayaꞌl chit kukꞌuꞌl tiꞌ kulochat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ.
As aꞌ ni valeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaj yol la chee sqiꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa nimla lochbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ nimolpeꞌ. As jik chit la qil isuuchil tiꞌ iqꞌajsaleꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ,
tan jit kuxh vatz u Tiixheꞌ la kubꞌankat. Pet sevatz as vatz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ unpajte.

As kat unchaj bꞌen umaꞌt u qitzꞌin qatzik tiꞌ chajaak uvaꞌ ootzimal sqaꞌn uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn chit itxumbꞌal nibꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ elochpeꞌ tiꞌ inimal viyol u Tiixheꞌ. As ayaꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ bꞌen ilochat ex, tan kꞌujleꞌl chit ikꞌuꞌl setiꞌ.

As u Tito uvaꞌ la oon sexoꞌl unpajte, as unmool chit vibꞌ stukꞌ, tan niloch in tiꞌ ipaxsal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Cristo. As unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ xekel stiꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ ni bꞌanon ivatz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As ni toksa chajaak iqꞌii u Cristo tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ.

Estiꞌeꞌ la val sete, achaꞌv ekꞌulat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatikeꞌ uveꞌ la ooni. As bꞌaꞌn etxumbꞌal la ebꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ exoꞌnit chajaak, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la tootzi chajaak uvaꞌ an chit u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val te chajaak setiꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat chiibꞌ in setiꞌ. As ech tootzit unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ unpajte uvaꞌ echen tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
